name: dsh-compact-threshold
description: One settings card that gives every DSH agent preset its own compaction threshold: the plugin authors <mode>-compact-<ratio> preset copies with compaction-basic.thresholdRatio rewritten and adopts one as the default Agent mode (标准 > 创造 > 极简 > ptc, any copy before a mode without a threshold), so 0.4 (or any value) applies to every mode instead of only a hand-made preset. Works on both DSH settings generations: the 0.1.5-rc.x plugin-owned settings namespace and the 0.1.7+ volatile profile-entry form.
